environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with TCP passthrough on port 443. The Flask app runs via gunicorn with 4 workers. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or proxy filtering. SQLite database stored on local EBS volume at /var/app/data/users.db with read-write permissions for the app user.

config.database: SQLite on local EBS, rw for app user
